notes: Runs on a fixture where .claude/state/model-mode.md already exists with the default preset (the output of ugt-nextjs-full-setup step 4). Prompts stay in Thai: they simulate real user input.

evals.name: switch-to-god
evals.prompt: งานนี้สำคัญมาก อัดคุณภาพเต็มที่เลย เปลี่ยนเป็นโหมด god ให้หน่อย
evals.expected_output: Rewrites .claude/state/model-mode.md wholesale from the template with the god column (code/fix = opus, plan/review/diagnose = fable, mechanical rows stay haiku), confirms the new mode and that it is committed team-wide, touches nothing else
assertions: Write-code and fix-a-bug rows become opus; plan/review/diagnose rows become fable
Run-tests/verify and docs rows remain haiku
handoff.md and docs/project-context/ are not modified
Does not claim the main session model changed and does not attempt to run /model

evals.name: main-model-boundary
evals.prompt: ช่วยเปลี่ยน model หลักของ session นี้เป็น opus ให้หน่อย
evals.expected_output: Explains the main session model can only be changed by the user via /model, does not edit model-mode.md (no preset was requested), and offers /ugt-model-mode god if what they actually want is stronger subagents
assertions: Tells the user to run /model themselves
Does not claim to have switched any model

evals.name: switch-to-auto
evals.prompt: ไม่อยากมานั่งสลับโหมดเอง ให้เลือกความแรง model ตามความยากของแต่ละงานเลย
evals.expected_output: Rewrites .claude/state/model-mode.md wholesale from the auto template verbatim (rule-based rows judged on ambiguity / blast radius / risk domain; mechanical rows stay haiku), confirms auto judges per task at dispatch time without ever rewriting model-mode.md per task, touches nothing else
assertions: Non-mechanical rows contain the auto rules (not fixed single models)
Run-tests/verify and docs rows remain haiku
Explains judgment happens at dispatch time and model-mode.md is never rewritten per task
handoff.md and docs/project-context/ are not modified
